verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows only narrow, task-specific exports (e.g., pushing individual issues to Jira, PR-based fixes) but no documented capability to export a full account's data (projects, scan history, findings) in an open, portable format for offline use or migration. Community evidence even suggests friction when leaving Snyk (projects marked 'abandoned' after moving off GitHub), reinforcing the absence of a genuine data-portability/export-and-leave feature.
